proposals.expected_signal: If the current search space is overvaluing auxiliary contrastive signals on ML-1M under frozen full-sort NDCG@10, this run should underperform a plain pairwise LightGCN-style setup or show unstable/no
proposals.failure_mode: Contrastive auxiliary loss dilutes ranking gradients on dense-popularity interactions, yielding flat or worse NDCG@10 despite clean optimization.
proposals.hypothesis: Adding self-supervised contrastive auxiliary training to a lightweight graph propagation backbone is not a reliable gain in this protocol; a negative result would falsify the assumption that extra self-supervision is broadly helpful here.
